addons.name: robin
addons.title: Robin
addons.summary: Robin's own knowledge: your mail, calendar, people, facts, open loops and its decisions. Always on.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything Robin holds: mail and calendar events across accounts and providers, people (kind:person: name, addresses, relationship and your notes), and your earlier conversation with Robin (kind:chat), offline and fast; best match first, recent first among equals.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one local thread by its Robin thread_id.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one local message by Robin message_id, including available capped plain text.

tools.name: query_calendar
tools.description: Read local occurrences between from and to (dates and times; without an offset they are the owner's local time), maximum 90 days.

tools.name: explain_decision
tools.description: Read a recorded decision and provenance for one Robin message_id.

tools.name: facts
tools.description: Read the owner's facts: typed key-value pairs such as passport.expiry or passport.issuing_country, with where each came from.

tools.name: query_loops
tools.description: List open loops: requests the owner sent and waits on (kind waiting), replies the owner owes (owed) and promises the owner made (promised), each with the other side, what was asked, since when, topics such as passport_renewal, when Robin follows it up and whether that is overdue.

tools.name: propose_fact
tools.description: Propose saving one fact about the owner, such as passport.expiry 2028-06-14, when the owner states it or you read it in their mail.

tools.name: schedule_reminder
tools.description: Remind the owner of something later, once or on a repeat: a push and a card in Chat at that time, with Done and Snooze.

tools.name: schedule_task
tools.description: Have Robin do something later or on a schedule, when the owner asks for that ("every Monday morning, check …", "tomorrow at 8, look up …"): at each time Robin runs a turn of its own with instruction as what to do, using its read tools, and its answer appears in Chat with a push.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List the owner's reminders and scheduled tasks still to come (and with include_finished, recent done and cancelled ones): id, text, the schedule in words, state (active, paused, fired: waiting for Done) and next times.

tools.name: cancel_reminder
tools.description: Cancel one of the owner's reminders by its id from list_reminders, when the owner asks.

tools.name: find_person
tools.description: Find people the owner deals with by name, email address, relationship or part of any: each with the owner's name for them, relationship and notes, their addresses, first and last contact, how many mails and calendar events they appear in, and recent threads (use read_thread).

tools.name: propose_person
tools.description: Propose a change to a person for the owner to save: their name, relationship (e.g.

addons.name: fastmail
addons.title: Fastmail
addons.summary: Fastmail mail and calendars: connect accounts in Settings, read on arrival, open messages as HTML.

addons.name: google
addons.title: Google
addons.summary: Gmail and Google Calendar: connect accounts in Settings, read on arrival, open messages as HTML.

addons.name: orders
addons.title: Orders and parcels
addons.summary: Orders and parcels from your mail: what you bought, where it is, and deliveries that went wrong.

addons.name: maps
addons.title: Maps
addons.summary: Travel times with traffic, and places you mention: address, phone, website and opening hours.

tools.name: travel_time
tools.description: Travel time between two places from Google Maps, with predicted traffic when driving: for planning a trip, a school run or when to leave.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a place on Google Maps, such as a restaurant, venue, shop or school the owner mentions: name, address, phone, website, opening hours, whether it is open now and its status (closed for good, temporarily closed).

addons.name: phone
addons.title: Phone
addons.summary: Robin's phone line: call Robin from an allowed number, and Robin places calls for you. Every call is in Calls.

tools.name: propose_call
tools.description: Propose a phone call Robin places for the owner, for example to book a table or ask a business a question.

tools.name: propose_calls
tools.description: Propose 2 to 10 calls for one errand together (for example asking several shops the same question): each item is a propose_call brief.

tools.name: propose_text
tools.description: Propose a text (SMS) Robin sends for the owner from one of Robin's US numbers.

tools.name: recent_texts
tools.description: Text conversations on Robin's numbers, newest first: the other number, which of Robin's numbers, the latest text and how many are unread.

tools.name: read_texts
tools.description: One text conversation by number from recent_texts: the texts both ways, oldest first, with what Robin sent and whether it went.

tools.name: recent_calls
tools.description: The calls Robin answered or placed, newest first: who, when, how long, how it ended and, for calls Robin placed, the result.

tools.name: read_call
tools.description: One call by call_id from recent_calls: its summary, what was agreed, follow-ups, the brief it was placed from, and the transcript.

limits.name: outbound_minutes
limits.description: minutes of calls Robin places a month

limits.name: practice_minutes
limits.description: voice minutes of practice calls a month (both sides count)

addons.name: research
addons.title: Research
addons.summary: Answers from the web: Robin searches with the terms you approve and reads the pages for you.
addons.reach: The web, through the model vendor's search, with the search terms you approve

tools.name: research
tools.description: Look the owner's question up on the web: a separate researcher with web search and a browser reads current pages and returns an answer with its sources.

addons.name: browser
addons.title: Browser
addons.summary: A confined browser for research and errands Robin runs for you; never used from chat directly.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open an http or https address in this run's browser and read its first part.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read the current page again, or a later part of it (part 2, 3, …).

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click element n from the last read, then read the page it leads to.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into text field n from the last read, replacing what is there; submit presses Enter.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose an option, by its visible text, in list n from the last read.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page and read it.

addons.name: images
addons.title: Remote images in mail
addons.summary: Loads a message's remote images when you ask, and senders' logos, fetched by Robin, never by your browser.
addons.reach: Any public website, for the images a message shows and senders' logos only

tools.name: fetch_image
tools.description: One remote image an email shows, fetched over https without cookies or referrer.

tools.name: fetch_logo
tools.description: One brand logo (an SVG) a sender's domain publishes for BIMI, fetched over https without cookies or referrer.

tools.name: find_icon
tools.description: The icon a sender's site declares on its homepage (<link rel="icon">), as a URL only.

addons.name: jev
addons.title: Jev (TypeSafe)
addons.summary: Jev, a fast mail reader that decides most messages first, with Claude where it matters.

tools.name: jev_decide
tools.description: One decision from TypeSafe's Jev: answers to the given questions about state, with probabilities.
